meta.name: add-tavily-tool
meta.description: Add Tavily Search and Extract as keyless remote MCP tools for selected NanoClaw agent groups. Use when installing Tavily web search or URL extraction without an API key.

copy.tagline: 添加免密钥的搜索与网页提取能力到智能体组
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在用 NanoClaw 管理智能体，希望它们能直接搜索网页和提取内容
copy.tagline_en: Add keyless web search and extraction to your agent groups.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage NanoClaw agents and want them to search the web without an API key.

howto.what: 此技能让 Claude 为选定的 NanoClaw 小组安装无需密钥的 Tavily 搜索和网页提取工具，并在组内写入额度用尽时的付费升级指引。
howto.when: 当你想为某个 NanoClaw 小组安装无需密钥的 Tavily 搜索或网页提取时触发。

say.text: 给销售组安装无需密钥的 Tavily 搜索与网页提取。
say.note: Claude 会执行完整的安装流程。

say.text: 为客服组只添加 Tavily 的网页提取工具。
say.note: Claude 会只添加提取工具并验证。

say.text: 把 Tavily 搜索工具装到数据组。
say.note: Claude 会完成搜索工具安装并重启。

howto.what_en: This skill lets Claude install keyless Tavily search and web-page extraction tools for chosen NanoClaw agent groups, and writes upgrade instructions into each group for when the keyless quota runs out.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want to install Tavily web search or page extraction for a NanoClaw agent group without an API key.

say_en.text: Install keyless Tavily search and page extraction for the sales group.
Add only Tavily page extraction for the support group.
say_en.note: Claude configures just that tool and verifies.

say_en.text: Install the Tavily search tool for the data group.
say_en.note: Claude completes the install and restarts the group.
